rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the `DrawIOXMLTree` class into a new `DrawIOParser` class in `gbad_core/drawio.py`. The new class will encapsulate the core parsing logic and will return a structured representation of the graph.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote: **Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python @dataclass(frozen=True) class DrawIOXMLTree: # ... def individuals_and_arrows( self, strict_mode: bool, max_gap: float) -> Generator[ Individual | Arrow, None, None]: """ Returns as a generator all Individual and Arrow instances obtained when parsing the nodes and arrows of the draw.io XML graph fed into the DrawIOXMLTree instance upon its construction """ # ... ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `DrawIOParser` Class:** - Create a new class `DrawIOParser` in `gbad_core/drawio.py`. 2. **Move Core Logic:** - Move the core parsing logic from the `DrawIOXMLTree` class to the new `DrawIOParser` class. - The `__init__` method of `DrawIOParser` should take the Draw.io XML content as a string. 3. **Implement `parse()` Method:** - Create a `parse()` method in `DrawIOParser` that encapsulates the logic from the old `individuals_and_arrows` method. - The `parse()` method should return a list or generator of `Individual` and `Arrow` objects. 4. **Refactor Helper Methods:** - The various helper methods from `DrawIOXMLTree` (e.g., `_cell_with_id`, `_value_of`) should be moved to `DrawIOParser` as private methods.
